scope: Local source-release completeness review of Git-collectable pending files, relative source imports, version contracts, packaging inputs, desktop/mobile preparation, and current CI entrypoints. No product or historical report changed during this final review.

candidateSnapshot.note: Snapshot excludes this report; later release evidence and final atlas/document refresh are checked by the release owner before staging.

sourceCompleteness.method: Static relative quoted ESM imports on changed/new JS source outside evidence; existing prepared-resource/runtime proofs are separate checks.

excludedPublicationMaterial.note: Official synthetic examples and test screenshots/logs are intentional publication material. Both author-data/config and cache classifications use the same deny-path scan; zero does not imply a general security audit.

packaging.desktopModules: Recursive engine/scripts/web copy includes new pure modules, execution adapters, and Godot .gd/.tscn control/behavior support. Native Bevy tool is intentionally separately configured, not embedded.
packaging.mobileModules: Recursive engine/web copy includes pure modules; mobile packaging does not add Node, Godot/Bevy execution, or a device claim.
packaging.fullRepositoryArchiveCheck: Release owner separately creates and byte-checks the complete current source archive; this review used read-only enumeration plus an isolated real small-archive regression.

resolvedFinding.problem: Source archive INPUTS omitted the new Bevy Rust crate and all official examples, making documented sample/build commands incomplete from the archive. New Bevy target was not Git-ignored.
resolvedFinding.resolution: Added the exact Bevy crate and four explicit official sample directories; excluded Bevy target and sample local/snapshot/build/session/engine caches while retaining only canonical .viento/workspace.json markers.

regression.counting: Existing one-test regression was expanded; it overlaps the final full application run and must not be added to its total.
regression.coverage: An isolated real archive verifies both crate manifests/locks/src/tests and all official sample bytes against SHA-256 manifest; private extra example, generated native/WASM outputs, local bindings, projections/build/session and engine caches stay out, and source inputs remain untouched.

ci.currentChecks: Application workflow runs npm ci, shared Rust core tests, and the full JS/API/version application check; manual desktop matrix prepares recursive resources and builds installers.
ci.nonBlockingFollowUp: Bevy native crate is not yet a separate CI job; the current real 25-test Rust/tool proof is retained, and the executable is explicitly separately configured.

limits: Reviewer authored the packaging fix and expanded its existing regression; this is a separate final read-only pass, not an independent external security audit.
Static import scan does not prove arbitrary dynamic imports, device APIs, signing, GPU/rendering, or cross-platform installers.
No new large test suite, installer, device run, GitHub Release or tag was created by this review.
Final staged set, preservation hashes, complete archive bytes, and final app/atlas/results are release-owner checks; current CI was inspected, not remotely executed.
